title: B7 Soak: 600 s of 20 clients connecting, subscribing and disconnecting at random (half abruptly)
note: A publisher sends 500 msg/s to 50 subjects meanwhile. After the churn stops, every counter must return to zero: connections, subscriptions, and the interest each broker holds from its peers. Totals: 7527 connections, 22464 subscriptions, 3764 abrupt disconnects, 329581 deliveries. Only the LOCAL broker's counters are readable here; the remote brokers' stats are in their own logs.
